answer: An operator that abandons 141 aliases after a single epoch hence destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the horizon forfeiture publishes up in the signal totals with the bridge audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 26% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
